Class heat map

Every child, every letter, in one picture. Green is got it, blue is not yet, grey means never shown. Read down a column to find a letter the whole class is missing. Read across a row to find a child who needs a small group.

Small group plan

The letters your class is struggling with most, ranked, and exactly which children need each one. Print it and clip it to your plan book.

Send results to your Google Sheet

Active Alphabet gives you one web app link for the whole pilot, plus your classroom number. Paste the link once, pick your classroom number in Class setup, test it once, and every assessment sends itself from then on. Your data goes only to your own private Sheet, never anyone else's.
